Phantom Blade Zero Might Be This Year’s Most Stylish Action Game | IGN Preview
After half a day playing Phantom Blade Zero, it’s gone from mostly not on my radar to to the top of my wishlist this fall, and I truly cannot wait to dive back in later this month to see if it can deliver beyond those first handful of hours. At least for now, though, just about everything I’ve seen and played has made me more convinced that this is going to be one of the coolest action games of 2026.

text:
Animals Review
The new Netflix thriller Animals is tautly directed by Ben Affleck, who keeps the emphasis on the characters’ flawed humanity. None of the choices available to the protagonists are good ones, and the many “what would you do in this scenario?” questions the film poses keep the story compelling when the kidnapping plot itself ventures into formula.

text:
Xbox XP's First Task Should Be the Halo Movie We Never Got
Microsoft has just announced Xbox XP, a new division aimed at getting cool experiences – be they movies, TV shows, theme park attractions, etc. – made out of its many intellectual properties. And that's how Microsoft can erase the memory of the TV show you probably already forgot anyway. No, I'm not suggesting that they necessarily dust off Garland's 20-year-old script (unless it's awesome, then by all means, do it!), but by turning Halo into the movie we deserve but never got.
